description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy results for three sentiment analysis/annotation tools across two tweet-related categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” shown left to right, and the x-axis caption reads “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each category displays a grouped set of three bars corresponding to the legend: TEXTBLOB (white bar with black outline), VADER (white bar with diagonal hatching), and ChatGPT (solid green). For “Emoji Tweets,” the TEXTBLOB bar is approximately 0.33, the VADER bar is approximately 0.45, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 0.66. For “Overall Tweet,” the TEXTBLOB bar is approximately 0.40, the VADER bar is approximately 0.47, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 0.65. The bars are arranged side-by-side within each category (not stacked), there is no visible sorting beyond the fixed left-to-right category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct fill styles and the legend.
